items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Fred Washington? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. When your hair has turned silver. That's right. When your hair has turned silver. What were you doing in Hot Springs? You were taking the leg. Well, I had my money. I was making my money so much. Yeah. And you just went up there to take your money? That's right. I went up there twice.

They have plenty of support up there? Well, I could have got a job playing in a nightclub up there. I went and I touched that pen and said, you say, how long are you going to be here, Fred? I said, well, I'm just here for 21 days. I'm going back home. He said, why don't you stay here? You have a job playing at camp if you want. I said, I'm going back to my lottery. I was making an old 250 a week, you know? It was good money 20 years ago. 25, 30 years ago, you know? Did you ever go out to Chicago? Yeah, I stayed…
What year was it? 1922. That's a good one, isn't it?
